name: OIDC (GitHub Actions) role trust with an org-wide subject (repo:example-org/*) -> HIGH federated-subject expansion
note: IAM-804: a Federated OIDC principal (token.actions.githubusercontent.com) whose sub condition is org-wide (repo:example-org/*) trusts an organization-wide set of workloads, not one specific workload. The audience (aud) check is recognized as a valid CONSTRAINT (it does not lower the broad-subject finding). Severity HIGH. The finding must NOT claim every repository can assume the role (a matching token + workflow context are out of scope) and must recommend constraining sub to a repository + branch/environment. The assumed role's permissions remain out of scope / unknown.
